Faults:
Out let temperature
exceeding the
temperature limit
Possible Cause:
Might be inlet water to
HEU not available
Corrective action:
Check inlet water availability
with a temperature of 10 º C
and flow of 40 lpm

Possible Cause:
Might circuit breaker in
PDP2 in off condition
Corrective action:
Check the breaker in on
condition and monitor the
230V AC supply in the input
connector

Possible Cause:
Might be the DM water
in the HEU tank in low
level
Corrective action:
Check the required DM
water level in the HEU
